accepted.label: Understanding Word2Vec Analogies
accepted.description: Understanding that word2vec embeddings encode semantic relationships, enabling analogy solving through vector arithmetic.
coverage_criteria: Explain how word2vec vectors can be used to solve analogies.
Provide an example of analogy using vector operations.
accepted.merge_rationale: This concept represents a definition-level understanding of semantic analogies using word2vec. It stands alone because the other candidate requires implementation-level behavior, which is a different teachable level.

accepted.label: Applying Vector Arithmetic for Analogies
accepted.description: Performing vector arithmetic (addition/subtraction) with word2vec embeddings to solve semantic analogy tasks.
coverage_criteria: Given a word vector equation, predict the expected result word for a simple analogy.
Explain that vector difference can capture the relationship between two words.
Perform vector addition or subtraction to solve an analogy task.
accepted.merge_rationale: This concept focuses on the procedural skill of solving analogies using vector operations, which is a deeper, implementation-level behavior distinct from mere explanation.
